title: TS-52 Fix the STS relay host header and the invoke-key length check
description: Found by the first live acceptance run (TS-50): POST /integration-test/session answers 403 'integration test caller required' on the deployed Lambda. conversation/src/auth/integration-test.ts relayStsGetCallerIdentityArn forwards the request's host header (STS_FORWARD_HEADERS includes host); on a Lambda Function URL that header is the function's own domain, but the caller signed the request for sts.amazonaws.com, so STS rejects the signature. Fix: never forward host (the relay must call STS with Host sts.amazonaws.com, derived from the STS URL), keep forwarding authorization, x-amz-date and x-amz-security-token. Also: timingSafeEqual throws on an invoke key of the wrong length (a 500): compare lengths first and answer the normal 403. Tests: vitest stubbing fetch asserting the outgoing request never carries the incoming host and still carries the signed headers; a vitest for a wrong-length invoke key returning 403; mutation-check both. Then re-run the live acceptance.
right_now_summary: The relay fix and invoke-key length check still need implementation, tests, and live acceptance.
